jobs.description:
1 Director Procurement, Animal Health Technology Solutions (Global) Reporting to the Executive Director responsible for Indirect Services and Animal Health Technology Solutions Procurement, you will lead a global team of approximately six procurement professionals. You will partner with senior leaders across manufacturing, supply chain, research and development, commercial operations, finance, quality, regulatory affairs, engineering and technology to deliver value, strengthen supply resilience and support business growth and transformation.

Primary location: (Netherlands, Austria, Germany or Spain)

What you will do: 

Bring energy, knowledge, innovation and leadership to carry out the following:

 * Develop and deliver global procurement and category strategies across direct materials, indirect services and capital investment.
 * Lead strategic sourcing, complex negotiations, contract management and supplier governance to deliver sustainable value, innovation and operational excellence.
 * Build trusted partnerships with senior business leaders and provide market, supplier and commercial insights to support business decisions and investment planning.
 * Manage supplier performance, third-party risk, due diligence, business continuity and compliance across global operations and supply chains.
 * Lead, coach and develop a global procurement team, creating an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing culture.
 * Advance procurement capabilities through process improvement, digital tools, data-informed decision-making and support for business transformation and integration activities

What skills you will need:

In order to excel in this role, you will more than likely have:

 * A bachelor's degree in business, supply chain management, engineering, information technology, finance, procurement or a related discipline.
 * At least seven years of progressive experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, category management or supplier relationship management, including leadership responsibilities.
 * Proven experience developing and implementing global sourcing and category strategies and leading complex commercial negotiations.
 * Experience supporting technology-enabled products, electronics, manufacturing operations or direct-material supply chains.
 * Knowledge of relevant categories such as electronic components, microchips, printed circuit board assemblies, plastics, metals, external manufacturing and technology solutions.
 * The ability to lead global teams and work effectively across functions, regions and a complex organizational structure.
 * Strong commercial judgement, financial analysis, negotiation, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
 * Excellent communication, stakeholder management and senior-level influencing skills, together with resilience, curiosity and an innovative mindset.
 * Professional fluency in English. Experience in animal health, medical devices, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, technology or manufacturing would be an advantage

Our singular focus is to empower those who care for animals, helping them manage their vital responsibility with confidence. Because when it comes to animal health, no one sees it like we do.

If you are ready to bring together procurement leadership, technology expertise and a passion for innovation, please apply today.

* Compensation packet varies by country and will be based on the successful candidate's qualifications and experience. For Austria, the minimum annual gross salary is EUR 100,300 and varies according to the qualifications and experience of the successful candidateCompensation for other locations will be aligned with local market practices and salary structures.

Job OverviewJoin ENPULSION as a Customer Success Engineer (f/m/x) and support our customers throughout their spacecraft missions - from pre-sales, to integration and testing, to on-orbit operations. You’ll act as the key technical partner, ensuring smooth product performance, clear communication, and successful mission outcomes in the fast-growing space industry.

• Recommend strategies and operational parameters based on telemetry and product performance.
• Provide on-orbit operations support to ensure products perform optimally in space.
• Deliver clear, concise, and well-written technical documentation.

• Technical or scientific education (FH/University/UAS/HTL), ideally a Master’s in Engineering, Physics, or Mechanical Engineering.

• Knowledge of satellite systems, launch services, or space data platforms is a plus.
• Knowledge of Python programming language.
• Solid understanding of electronics design and operation.
• Familiarity with manufacturing processes desirable.
• Experience with documentation tools, simulation software, or mission planning tools, as well as collaborative platforms (JIRA).

• Proactive, organized, and disciplined approach to independent work.
• Passionate about contributing to a fast-growing business and high-performing team.

Our culture is fast-paced and growth-oriented - a place where your work will have a real impact, and where you can truly leave your mark.
